issue_request: FHIR-17015 asked why the BackboneElement page publicly listed every BackboneElement specialization. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to move that list to a JSON file for the few people interested.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 13949. Git commit 80af10ced20a8c7a2ead7470a7d0adc81212d56c matches that revision and removed the Specializations section and <%backboneelementlist%> macro from source/backboneelement.html, converted the publisher helper to generate backbone-elements.json, wrote that file during publication, and added the downloads-page link.
additional_context: Later refactors removed the obsolete source/backboneelement.html redirect/source page and moved BackboneElement content to the active Type Framework page. Current source/fhir.ini maps backboneelement to source/types.html, source/types.html explains BackboneElement descendants without a specialization table, and source/downloads.html advertises backbone-elements.json. The current build serves the JSON file and renders the BackboneElement section without the old list. FHIR-26878 is an adjacent, already-reconciled BackboneType list issue but does not alter the FHIR-17015 table-to-JSON decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active source already matches the approved behavior and no stale table markers or conflicting community evidence were found.
